name: Calgary / YYC
why_sleep_here: Arrival/departure city; cheaper car rental and groceries stock-up. Fly-in, fly-out base.
why_not: Big city, 90+ min from mountains; not a destination for this trip.
kid_friendly_notes: Zoo/Heritage Park/Telus Spark if a delay day is needed; airport hotels have pools.
parking_or_car_notes: Airport rental depots; Costco/Safeway/Walmart for supplies; fuel cheapest here (see md).
lodging_cad_2026_range: GAP: Sept 2029; typical airport hotel range not verified

name: Canmore
park_or_area: Canmore, AB (Bow Valley, outside Banff NP)
why_sleep_here: Cheaper than Banff, quieter, more family condos with kitchens, big groceries, 25 min to Banff, central to Kananaskis/Smith-Dorrien.
why_not: Not inside the park; 60 min to Lake Louise; fewer walkable 'sights' than Banff.
kid_friendly_notes: Pocaterra Inn & Waterslide (indoor pool, waterslide, kids under 18 stay free, breakfast buffet per search snippet); Canmore Inn & Suites (indoor pool, slide); Canmore Nordic Centre, Grassi Lakes, Quarry Lake.
parking_or_car_notes: Free parking common at condos; no park pass needed to sleep here.
groceries_nearby: Safeway, Save-On-Foods, new IGA at Gateway at Three Sisters (opened April 2026).
lodging_cad_2026_range: Snapshot: Pocaterra $87 (Jan 2026) to $272 (summer snapshot); 2029 September GAP

name: Banff
why_sleep_here: Most to do on foot, bus system (Roam), Gondola, Cave and Basin, Bow Falls; best for a first-time family.
why_not: Priciest; summer-style crowds through mid-Sept; parking in town and at Lake Minnewanka/Moraine is the bottleneck.
kid_friendly_notes: Banff Rocky Mountain Resort (indoor pool, 2 hot tubs); Rundlestone Lodge (indoor pool); Banff Aspen Lodge and Canalta (free breakfast per Travelocity snapshot).
parking_or_car_notes: Park pass required (waived 19 Jun-7 Sep 2026 only; 2029 GAP); hotel parking usually included; Roam transit to Lake Louise lakes.
groceries_nearby: IGA (Marten St), Safeway (Banff Ave), Keller's Foods; hours GAP.
lodging_cad_2026_range: Snapshot: $100-$169 (spring, Banff Rocky Mountain Resort, Rundlestone); September 2029 GAP, expect well above

name: Lake Louise village
why_sleep_here: Closest to Lake Louise, Moraine Lake shuttle, Icefields Parkway start (saves 30-40 min vs Banff).
why_not: Few restaurants, thin groceries, high prices; no clear indoor pool + breakfast option found.
kid_friendly_notes: Lake Louise Inn; Fairmont Chateau (premium); Lake Louise Gondola/Wildlife; Moraine Lake road is shuttle-only (Parks Canada; GAP for 2029).
parking_or_car_notes: Lake louise lakeshore lots fill before sunrise; use Parks Canada shuttle.
groceries_nearby: Village Market in Samson Mall (small, pricey); Chateau General Store 7am-11pm summer (guide).
lodging_cad_2026_range: GAP: no usable September rate found

name: Field
why_sleep_here: Small, quiet, adjacent to Emerald Lake, Takakkaw Falls, Natural Bridge, Spiral Tunnels; very few crowds.
why_not: Tiny; almost no groceries/restaurants; Takakkaw road closed in winter (opens late June).
kid_friendly_notes: Cathedral Mountain Lodge, Emerald Lake Lodge (cabins, premium); short flat walks at Emerald Lake and Natural Bridge. GAP: lodging not sourced.
parking_or_car_notes: Park pass required (Yoho NP). Takakkaw Falls road seasonal (GAP 2029 dates). Time zone: GAP, verify whether Field observes Mountain or Pacific time.
groceries_nearby: GAP: small general store only, not verified

name: Golden
why_sleep_here: Cheaper rooms, real town, Kicking Horse Mountain Resort gondola/grizzly refuge, Kicking Horse River rafting; good base for Yoho and Glacier.
why_not: 45-60 min to Lake Louise/Field; 2h to Banff; Kicking Horse Canyon Hwy 1 can still close for incidents.
kid_friendly_notes: GAP: kid attractions (Kicking Horse Mountain Resort wildlife refuge, Golden Skybridge) from general knowledge, not sourced
parking_or_car_notes: Hwy 1 Kicking Horse Canyon Phase 4 completed 2024, four-lane, 100 km/h per CTV.
groceries_nearby: GAP: full-size grocery in Golden not verified

name: Radium Hot Springs
why_sleep_here: Hot pools (open through 2026 construction), bighorn sheep in town, Kootenay NP, Invermere lakes.
why_not: Hwy 93S construction June-Oct 2026 delays up to 45 min (Sinclair Canyon); 2029 status GAP.
kid_friendly_notes: Radium Hot Springs pools; Sinclair Canyon walk; Kootenay NP Marble Canyon, Paint Pots.
parking_or_car_notes: Parking at pools limited; Sinclair Canyon pullouts closed 2026.

name: Invermere
why_sleep_here: Lake Windermere beach, warmer/drier, cheaper; good for a 6-year-old beach day in early September.
why_not: Detour south, 2h+ to Banff; out of the way for Jasper-bound trips.
kid_friendly_notes: Lake Windermere, Kinsmen Beach, Panorama Resort nearby.
parking_or_car_notes: Easy parking; no park pass needed.

name: Kananaskis Village / Peter Lougheed PP
why_sleep_here: Quiet alternative to Banff; Peter Lougheed PP lakes (Upper Kananaskis, Spray), Highwood Pass (2,206 m).
why_not: Highway 40 Highwood Pass closed 1 Dec to 14 Jun (open in Sept); fewer restaurants; Smith-Dorrien is gravel.
kid_friendly_notes: Kananaskis Village resorts; Elbow Falls; Mt Kidd; Peter Lougheed visitor centre.
parking_or_car_notes: Kananaskis Conservation Pass required (GAP 2029 price); Smith-Dorrien/Hwy 742 is gravel: check rental contract.

name: Waterton townsite
why_sleep_here: Quiet, family-sized, deer in town, Red Rock Canyon, boat cruise, Prince of Wales Hotel; calmer than Banff.
why_not: Remote: 3h+ from Calgary, long dead-end; many services close by late Sept/Oct.
kid_friendly_notes: Prince of Wales Hotel (curiocity listing 2026: 11 May-5 Oct 2026, third-party); Cameron Lake; Waterton Shoreline Cruise (GAP).
parking_or_car_notes: Park pass required; lots small; Red Rock Parkway.
groceries_nearby: Small grocery in townsite; Pincher Creek has Co-op/Safeway-type (GAP).

name: Pincher Creek
why_sleep_here: Cheaper rooms 45 min from Waterton; real groceries/fuel.
why_not: Not scenic; adds 90 min round trip to Waterton.

name: Crowsnest Pass
why_sleep_here: Frank Slide interpretive centre, cheaper en route if returning to Calgary via Hwy 3/22.
why_not: Not a main destination; long route.

name: Jasper townsite
why_sleep_here: Dark skies, Maligne Lake, elk and sheep; recovery ongoing; lodging reduced since July 2024 wildfire.
why_not: 358 structures destroyed (initial assessment; 375 properties needed remediation; 93 in construction as of 2 Oct 2026 per municipality); two hotels not due until 2027; high occupancy (96% average summer 2026 per report).
kid_friendly_notes: Wapiti Campground open; GAP for hotel list.
parking_or_car_notes: Park pass required; limited housing/staff mean services thin.

name: Valemount
why_sleep_here: Cheaper than Jasper; Mount Robson 30 min; quiet.
why_not: Long drive to anywhere; not a sights base.

name: Mount Robson
why_sleep_here: Highest Canadian Rockies peak; Berg Lake viewpoint, Overlander Falls short walks.
why_not: Almost no lodging; Berg Lake Trail not a 6-year-old trip; Robson Visitor Centre services thin.
kid_friendly_notes: Kinney Lake is a long flat hike (GAP for conditions).
parking_or_car_notes: Free day-use parking; fuel at Valemount/Jasper.

name: Edmonton / YEG
why_sleep_here: Open-jaw drop-off; Jasper to Edmonton 3.5-4 h; one-way rental fee applies.
why_not: Big city; one-way fee GAP (no published quote found).
kid_friendly_notes: West Edmonton Mall waterpark, if flight is late.
parking_or_car_notes: Rental one-way drop to YEG: quote needed.
